0022600145.text: The New Orleans Pelicans host the Sacramento Kings in the Pelicans' fifth game of the season, with both teams winless at 0-4 and on four-game losing streaks. The Pelicans, 0-2 at home, sit 14th in the West and 4.5 games back in the Southwest, while the Kings, 0-2 on the road, are 15th in the West and 3 games back in the Pacific. New Orleans is without Yves Missi (out, knee bruise), and Jordan Poole is day-to-day with an ankle injury and is a game-time decision, while Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (out, Achilles surgery), Dylan Cardwell (out, calf strain), Keegan Murray (out, ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (out, dislocated knee). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Pelicans won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, but the most recent meeting was a 117-113 Sacramento win over New Orleans on April 3, 2026, in Sacramento.
